sources.title: Official Peppermill homepage lounge photograph
sources.establishes: Circular blue water/fire basin with central fire island, curved pink/red upholstered seating, chrome rails, bar stools and illuminated bar behind. Photo date not stated.

sources.title: Official Peppermill photos page
sources.establishes: Lounge basin and seating, chrome rails and glass shelves/backbar. No measured floor plan.

sources.title: Google Maps aerial of Peppermill retail block
sources.establishes: Peppermill hip roof and recessed well, west and east parking, Ross to south and neighboring stores. Capture date not displayed.

sources.title: Peppermill Link Magazine volume17 Summer2024, printedpage23 / PDFpage25
sources.establishes: Dining room photograph: long service counter, blue stools and curved booths with cyan stripe, dark tables, chrome edges, floral canopy, coloured glass shades and pink ceiling bands. No dimensioned floor plan.

sources.title: Google Street View east parking frontage, December2022
sources.establishes: Steep gray hip roof, blue eave strip, large italic lettering, parking/bollards and side entrance. Existing west entry is retained; other entry registration unresolved.
